Class ShapeClipperOffset

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Wraps a Clipper2Lib.ClipperOffset instance to offset polygons and polylines using the engine's world-space coordinate conventions.

Remarks

Input geometry is converted to Clipper's integer-based path representation using Scale, then written to the provided Clipper2Lib.Paths64 collection. This type reuses internal buffers to reduce allocations and is intended for repeated offset operations.

Methods

OffsetOpenPaths(Paths64, float, float, bool, ShapeClipperEndType, Paths64)

Offsets a collection of open Clipper paths and writes the resulting stroked outlines into result.

public void OffsetOpenPaths(Paths64 openPaths, float offsetPositive, float miterLimit, bool beveled, ShapeClipperEndType endType, Paths64 result)

Parameters

openPaths Paths64

The open input paths to offset.

offsetPositive float

The positive offset distance in world units used to build the stroked outlines.

miterLimit float

The miter limit to use when selecting join behavior for sharp corners.

beveled bool

Whether non-miter joins should use beveled corners instead of square corners.

endType ShapeClipperEndType

The end-cap style to use for each open path.

result Paths64

The destination collection that will be cleared and populated with the generated offset paths.

Remarks

If openPaths is empty, or offsetPositive is less than or equal to zero, no output is produced. The method assumes the supplied paths are already expressed in Clipper's integer coordinate space.

OffsetPaths(Paths64, float, float, bool, Paths64)

Offsets a collection of closed Clipper paths and writes the resulting paths into result.

public void OffsetPaths(Paths64 paths, float offset, float miterLimit, bool beveled, Paths64 result)

Parameters

paths Paths64

The closed input paths to offset.

offset float

The offset distance in world units. Positive values expand paths and negative values shrink them.

miterLimit float

The miter limit to use when selecting join behavior for sharp corners.

beveled bool

Whether non-miter joins should use beveled corners instead of square corners.

result Paths64

The destination collection that will be cleared and populated with the generated offset paths.

Remarks

If paths is empty, or offset is zero, no output is produced. The method assumes the supplied paths are already expressed in Clipper's integer coordinate space.

OffsetPolygon(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, float, float, bool, Paths64)

Offsets a closed polygon and writes the resulting paths into result.

public void OffsetPolygon(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonCCW, float offset, float miterLimit, bool beveled, Paths64 result)

Parameters

polygonCCW IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The polygon vertices to offset. The polygon is expected to be wound counterclockwise.

offset float

The offset distance in world units. Positive values expand the polygon and negative values shrink it.

miterLimit float

The miter limit to use when selecting join behavior for sharp corners.

beveled bool

Whether non-miter joins should use beveled corners instead of square corners.

result Paths64

The destination collection that will be cleared and populated with the generated offset paths.

Remarks

If offset is zero, this method returns a single path equivalent to the input polygon. If the polygon contains fewer than three points, no output is produced.

OffsetPolyline(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, float, float, bool, ShapeClipperEndType, Paths64)

Offsets an open polyline and writes the resulting stroked outline paths into result.

public void OffsetPolyline(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polyline, float offsetPositive, float miterLimit, bool beveled, ShapeClipperEndType endType, Paths64 result)

Parameters

polyline IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The polyline vertices to offset.

offsetPositive float

miterLimit float

The miter limit to use when selecting join behavior for sharp corners.

beveled bool

endType ShapeClipperEndType

The end-cap style to use for the open polyline.

result Paths64

The destination collection that will be cleared and populated with the generated offset paths.

Remarks
